description: If a finite clause representation is equivalent to \(\neg A\) in the shared propositional syntax, \(A\) is valid if and only if that clause set has a resolution refutation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.formula_refutation.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α)
  (L : List (List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropLiteral α)))
  (h :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent A.neg
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.cnfFormula L)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Tautology A ↔
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Derives (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ofCnf L) ∅
